entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This reaction is incredible. I'm[n]honestly shocked to see it.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: It is only natural that people[n]are surprised. Even the police[n]were struggling to catch him.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah. By the way, you said you[n]were called in by the principal?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Did something happen?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It was regarding my investigation[n]of the incident with Mr. Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Don't worry. I didn't mention[n]a word about any of you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I essentially told him I was[n]unable to find any information.
Thank you, Makoto.
Are you going to be OK?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Don't mention it.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I will.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I've graduated from my role as[n]the exemplary honor student.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: From now on, I'm going to be[n]more honest with myself.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's quite a refreshing feeling.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're you gonna do now? Wanna[n]stay with the Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's my intention, assuming[n]it wouldn't be any trouble.
Welcome aboard.
You sure about this?
I dunno...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It'd actually be a big problem[n]if you didn't stick with us.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Of course.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, she already knows our[n]secret. There's no reason to[n]be hesitating now.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We should allow her to join us.[n]It would be greatly convenient.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well then, I hope I can continue[n]getting along with all of you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: An advisor, huh...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This new teammate of ours is pretty[n]promising! We'll be able to do even[n]more now!
